description: Government grants reported on Form 990 Part VIII line 1e
irs_instruction_citation: Form 990 Part VIII (Statement of Revenue) line 1e, "Government grants (contributions)"; 2024 Instructions for Form 990, p. 39. Part/line stable across TY2020-2024. Contributions in the form of grants/similar payments from local/state/federal/foreign government sources, RECEIVED by the filer (distinct from line 2 program-service revenue and from Schedule I grants paid TO governments). Verified against IRS instructions 2026-05-29 (gate 5 / ADR 0017 sec 2.3).
notes: XPath confirmed by Phase C verifier (2026-05-22) against all 14 in-scope (year version) bundles; 2024:5.1 and 2024:5.2 tuples added 2026-05-27 after 120-filing empirical confirmation (see decisions/0002 Outcome). Older NODC variants (Form990PartVIII/GovernmentGrants; IRS990/GovernmentGrants) do not resolve in 2020+ XSDs.

description: Total program-related investments reported on Form 990-PF, Summary of Program-Related Investments (Part VIII-B for TY2021-2024; Part IX-B for TY2020)
irs_instruction_citation: Form 990-PF "Summary of Program-Related Investments", aggregate total (sum of lines 1-3 in the Amount column); 2024 Instructions for Form 990-PF, p. 31. NOTE form renumbering: this is Part VIII-B for TY2021-2024 but Part IX-B for TY2020 (the NODC PF_09_ name is 2020-anchored). Total equals the program-related investments figure carried to Part XI line 1b. Verified against IRS instructions 2026-05-29 (gate 5 / ADR 0017 sec 2.3).
notes: XPath confirmed by Phase C verifier (2026-05-22); 2024:5.1 and 2024:5.2 tuples added 2026-05-27 after 120-filing empirical confirmation. Older NODC variant (SumOfProgramRelatedInvestments/Total) does not resolve in 2020+ XSDs.
